assertions: Classic CDocument XSAXSerializable now adds native root namespaces, runs original nscleanup and dispatches original node saxify methods over actual libxml2 nodes. Element namespace/attribute order and retained actual AttributeList references, text callbacks and source extended-handler gates for CDATA/comments/PI are preserved. AttributeList now owns the real WeakImplHelper<XAttributeList,XCloneable>, acquired clones and native member destruction; manifest callers use actual UNO attribute references. Incomplete duplicate UDK SAX declarations are replaced by their correct offapi IDL owners and original existing XLocator. No browser DOM or serializer/metadata provider is manufactured. Native OSL/physical ABI/std allocator traces and fast SAX/IO facets remain unqualified. Source qadevOOo XCloneable configured criteria and applicable classic serializerTest query are ported; original fast serializerTest remainder is explicitly pending. SfxDocumentMetaData and final DOCX/XLSX core/shell/UI acceptance remain unfinished.

AttributeList constructor failure now unwinds partially copied native members and qualified weak-base state. AppendAttributeList releases the already acquired name temporary if an actual foreign value getter throws. An application-owned real UNO forwarding list raises RuntimeException after one entry; the source RTL string refcount returns to its original value without private mutation. This restores original C++ automatic temporary/member destruction rather than changing upstream logic.
record.capability: Native DOM classic SAX serialization and real attribute-list UNO lifetime
gaps: Fast SAX and IO facets are unadvertised until concrete owners exist; full domtest serializerTest fast branch remains pending.
